title: Authenticated Wasm source-kernel route telemetry
objective: Derive every source-kernel telemetry capability from authenticated production pack metadata and emit fixed non-forgeable private route observations for graph, matrix/polynomial, P1, and number-field kernels

oracles: Generated native-kernel manifest and production pack receipt

handoff.summary: Replaced the evaluator's five-entry source table with complete route authority derived from the generated production pack index. The loader admits authority only after SHA-256 verification of pack bytes, validates every fully compiled kernel against its pack identity module, and retains the logicalSource-to-kernel capability map in private WeakMap state. Registered adversarial tests prove graph, matrix, polynomial, P1, and number-field observations and reject copied resolvers, mutable manifest relabeling, digest tampering, and unauthenticated precompiled modules.
risks: A WebAssembly.Module supplied directly remains callable but intentionally cannot emit receipt-backed source-kernel telemetry because its original bytes cannot be authenticated by the loader.

The full production build/browser corpus could not be receipted in this lane after merging current ell-lseries because unrelated hyperelliptic native-audit metrics, lazy __all__ strict errors, and a new unregistered number-field test currently fail aggregate gates.
next_steps: Integrate b4b1620f and c92487a2 plus follow-ups 8d2eb03b, 972421a1, de8282bc and the final handoff commit, or merge agent/wasm-kernel-route-instrumentation.

After resolving the aggregate integration blockers, rebuild packages/flint-wasm so dist/wasm-pack-loader.mjs and the production receipt include the new loader, then run the public Chromium/Firefox/WebKit workload corpus and confirm all source-kernel calls appear as fixed kernel:<id> routes.
